text: So sorry to bother you this late, I know you must be busy. I'm looking after my grandson who is 5 months old. His temperature is 38.5. He's got a runny nose, sometimes it sounds a bit blocked, and he keeps sneezing, it started yesterday. Also he's not done a poo for three days and he's quite grumpy with it, bless him. He is wide awake though, watching me and babbling, very alert, so I'm sure he's alright really. I just didn't want to leave it in case. Thank you and sorry again
